name: foodify
description: foodify — demo de menú digital con realidad aumentada (MVP)

scripts.optimize:model: gltf-transform resize models/original/tiny_planet_friends_3d-mug-2923.glb models/_tmp.glb --width 1024 --height 1024 && gltf-transform optimize models/_tmp.glb models/foodify-mug.glb --compress draco --simplify false && rm models/_tmp.glb
scripts.build:variants: mkdir -p models/variants && cp models/foodify-mug.glb models/variants/foodify-mug-s100.glb && gltf-transform resize models/original/tiny_planet_friends_3d-mug-2923.glb models/variants/_base.glb --width 1024 --height 1024 && gltf-transform optimize models/variants/_base.glb models/variants/foodify-mug-s75.glb --compress draco --simplify --simplify-ratio 0.75 && gltf-transform optimize models/variants/_base.glb models/variants/foodify-mug-s50.glb --compress draco --simplify --simplify-ratio 0.50 && gltf-transform optimize models/variants/_base.glb models/variants/foodify-mug-s30.glb --compress draco --simplify --simplify-ratio 0.30 && rm models/variants/_base.glb
